hero.intro: Maa Kamakhya Darbar Fragrances, Kanpur. Since 1965.
hero.headline_en: The fragrance of India, made by hand.
hero.text: Since 1965 our family has made the incense India lights every morning. Tiranga, Sacred and Sacred Selections come from ten plants, six of them in Kanpur, for homes across India and now the world.

slides.caption: Thirteen million sticks leave our plants every day.
slides.alt: Aerial view of the plant in evening light: the Prakash Industries admin block, a solar-panelled factory roof and fields beyond

slides.caption: Ten plants, six of them in Kanpur.
slides.alt: The second plant from above, with solar panels on the terrace and a truck being loaded at the gate

slides.caption: More than a thousand women make what we sell.
slides.alt: The women of Sacred standing together on the steps of the plant entrance

story.heading: Six decades, one family business
story.lede: It began with printed cartons in Kanpur. It grew into one of north India's best-loved incense houses.

panels.title: A print and box unit
panels.text: The family learns how products are made, packed and moved across north India, one printed carton at a time.
panels.alt: A printer feeding card into a hand-fed platen press, with stacks of printed cartons on the table

panels.title: Tiranga is born
panels.text: Thirty years of packaging know-how becomes an incense house. The first Tiranga agarbatti leaves Kanpur.
panels.alt: Two women rolling incense paste onto bamboo sticks in a small agarbatti unit

panels.title: Ten plants, 500+ cities
panels.text: Over a thousand women artisans, thirteen million sticks a day, and a distribution network across India.
panels.alt: The Prakash Industries admin block and factory buildings, seen from above

panels.title: Beyond India
panels.text: Sacred Selections takes the house abroad for the first time, with small-batch incense made for homes around the world.
panels.alt: Sacred Selections incense with natural wood and paper

leadership.heading: The people at the helm
leadership.lede: Six decades on, the family business is led from Kanpur by its Chairman and its Managing Director.

brands.heading: One house, three brands
brands.lede: Each made for a different moment of worship, and a different shelf. All three come out of the same plants and the same standards.

tiranga.tagline: Desh ki khushboo. The everyday agarbatti of north India.
tiranga.text: Familiar fragrances at honest prices, on the shelf of the neighbourhood shop in 500+ cities. Loved by rural and middle-income India for three decades.
tiranga.alt: Three generations of a family lighting incense at a home mandir

sacred.text: Premium incense, dhoop, havan cups and poojan samagri, developed together for the full ritual. Home of the Diwali Poojan Kit.
sacred.alt: Hands arranging incense, flowers and a brass thali for puja

selections.tagline: Small-batch incense for homes around the world.
selections.text: Charcoal-free sticks, hand-packed in Kanpur in keepsake boxes. Our first collection made for international shelves, and the only one we sell directly online.
selections.alt: Sacred Selections incense in a green keepsake box

products.heading: What we make
products.lede: Four everyday formats from our own plants, sold under Tiranga and Sacred through local shops and on tirangaagarbatti.com.

diwali.heading: The Sacred Diwali Poojan Kit
diwali.text: 121 poojan samagri with Laxmi, Ganesh and Kuber idols, packed in one box so nothing is missing when the first diya is lit.
diwali.alt: The Sacred Diwali Poojan Kit open under marigold garlands, with Laxmi, Ganesh and Kuber idols, the Shri Yantra and diyas

mini.label: Or the smaller kit
mini.name: Sacred Mini Diwali Poojan Kit
mini.text: 32 samagri with Laxmi, Ganesh and Kuber yantras

making.heading: How a stick is made
making.lede: Every stick passes through four stages and many pairs of hands before the carton closes.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Women artisans roll the masala onto bamboo by hand. Over a thousand of them work with us across our units.
steps.alt: Hands rolling incense masala onto bamboo

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Sticks dry on racks batch by batch, until each one burns evenly from tip to end.
steps.alt: Rolled incense sticks drying on trays in a rack room

steps.title: Fragrance
steps.text: Each batch is perfumed in Kanpur to the house formula, the way it has been since 1995.
steps.alt: A perfumer pouring fragrance oil over a tray of incense sticks

steps.title: Pack
steps.text: Sticks are checked, counted and packed in our own units, then sent to distributors in 500+ cities.
steps.alt: Women counting incense sticks into cartons at a packing table

thought.heading: Tiranga is all about the people
thought.lede: Stories from our floors, our families and the people who carry Desh ki Khushboo across India.

md.caption: IBC Corporate Awards, The Leela Mumbai, 2017
md.name: Pandit Narendra Sharma
md.text: Short conversations with Panditji on faith, fragrance and building an Indian brand that is sold in 500+ cities, from the factory floor to the puja room.
md.alt: Pandit Narendra Sharma holding the India's No. 1 Brands award for Tiranga Agarbatti at the IBC Corporate Awards 2017, The Leela Mumbai

awards.heading: Awards and media
awards.lede: Recognition for the house, and the conversations its people are part of.

pushkar.heading: Official agarbatti partner of the Pushkar Mahayagya
pushkar.text: One of the largest yagyas of its kind, held across a 10.5-acre yagya shala.

library.heading: Find a fragrance
library.lede: Pick a note to see which of our brands carry it, and where to buy it.

global.heading: Built across India. Now leaving home.
global.text: Sacred Selections carries six decades of making into our first international collection.

partner.heading: Partner with us
partner.lede: Distribution, export or private label. Tell us what you need and we'll reply with a range, samples and a production slot.

products_page.heading: Our products
products_page.lede: Agarbatti, dhoop, havan cups and poojan kits from Tiranga and Sacred, made in our own plants in Kanpur. Open any product to see the details, then buy it on our store or ask about bulk supply.
